source_title: Data on the Web Best Practices
claim_supported: Recommends version indicators version history persistent identifiers version-specific identifiers provenance vocabulary reuse appropriate formalization and avoiding breaking API changes.
limitations: Web data publication guidance rather than a self-storage semantic contract; it does not define field compatibility classify a specific change or prove operational adoption.

claim_supported: Distinguishes dimensions that identify an observation measures that represent the phenomenon and attributes such as units scale and status needed to interpret a value.
limitations: Statistical linked-data vocabulary rather than a facility KPI policy; it does not define the proposed register establish denominators or validate an operating metric.

source_title: OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Structural Specification and Functional-Style Syntax Second Edition
claim_supported: Defines ontology and version IRIs imports declarations axioms annotations prior-version backward-compatible and incompatible-with vocabulary.
limitations: Formal ontology language only; annotations or logical consistency do not prove a field meaning is correct compatible adopted current or safe for a decision.

claim_supported: Defines shapes targets constraints validation results and conformance reports for RDF data graphs.
limitations: The stable 2017 Recommendation is used while SHACL 1.2 remains draft work; conformance proves declared structural constraints only not meaning truth authority or compatibility.

claim_supported: Defines schema identifiers dialect vocabularies references evaluation and annotations used by the companion semantic-contract schema.
limitations: Structural and applicator semantics only; schema identity and conformance do not establish business meaning source authority completeness compatibility or safe migration.

claim_supported: Defines validation assertion keywords for constraining instance types values strings numbers arrays and objects.
limitations: Validates declared instance constraints only; it cannot decide whether two field definitions are semantically compatible or operationally safe.

claim_supported: Defines provenance concepts for entities activities agents attribution association delegation derivation invalidation revision and generation.
limitations: Provenance does not prove a definition source transformation or compatibility judgment is correct authoritative complete current or accepted.

claim_supported: Defines temporal entities instants intervals positions durations reference systems and temporal relations used to keep valid-time and change intervals explicit.
limitations: Temporal vocabulary does not choose the governing business clock establish freshness or determine whether a change is breaking.

claim_supported: Defines event context attributes including id source specversion type subject time datacontenttype and dataschema that can carry schema identity across change events.
limitations: Interoperable event envelope only; dataschema presence does not prove semantic compatibility event truth authority migration completion or consumer reconciliation.

claim_supported: Defines classes and properties for quantities units dimensions and types used to identify unit and scale meaning explicitly.
limitations: General quantity and unit vocabulary rather than a self-storage metric catalog; a unit IRI does not define population denominator calculation or decision fitness.

source_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework AI RMF 1.0
claim_supported: Supports mapping intended purpose context risk tolerance knowledge limits data dependencies human-AI roles measurement and lifecycle risk.
limitations: Voluntary use-case-agnostic framework currently under revision; it does not prescribe this register validate a model certify a system or prove a field safe for AI-assisted action.

source_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile NIST AI 600-1
claim_supported: Describes risks including confabulation automation bias information integrity data privacy and human-AI configuration relevant when changed definitions enter retrieval or generated outputs.
limitations: Voluntary cross-sector profile; it does not detect semantic drift establish compatibility validate a model or prove this authored method effective.
